113 |     /// Replace data in a column in the dataset with new data. This is used for
114 |     /// null column population where we replace an entirely null column with a
115 |     /// new column that has data.
116 |     ///
117 |     /// This operation will only allow replacing files that contain the same schema
118 |     /// e.g. if the original files contain columns A, B, C and the new files contain
119 |     /// only columns A, B then the operation is not allowed. As we would need to split
120 |     /// the original files into two files, one with column A, B and the other with column C.
121 |     ///
122 |     /// Corollary to the above: the operation will also not allow replacing files unless the

124 |     ///

126 |     /// the column being replaced, the operation is not allowed.

1842 |     fn test_field_path_parsing() {
1843 |         // Simple paths without quotes
1844 |         assert_eq!(

1846 |             vec!["a".to_string(), "b".to_string(), "c".to_string()]
1847 |         );
1848 | 
1849 |         // Single quoted field with dots
1850 |         assert_eq!(
1851 |             parse_field_path("`simple.name.with.dot`").unwrap(),
1852 |             vec!["simple.name.with.dot".to_string()]
1853 |         );
1854 | 
1855 |         // Path with quoted field containing dots
1856 |         assert_eq!(
1857 |             parse_field_path("parent.`child.with.dot`.normal").unwrap(),
1858 |             vec![
1859 |                 "parent".to_string(),
1860 |                 "child.with.dot".to_string(),
1861 |                 "normal".to_string()
1862 |             ]
1863 |         );
1864 |

1866 |         assert_eq!(
1867 |             parse_field_path("`field.with.dot`.child").unwrap(),
1868 |             vec!["field.with.dot".to_string(), "child".to_string()]
1869 |         );
1870 | 
1871 |         // Simple field
1872 |         assert_eq!(
1873 |             parse_field_path("simple").unwrap(),
1874 |             vec!["simple".to_string()]
1875 |         );
1876 | 
1877 |         assert_eq!(
1878 |             parse_field_path("tags[*]").unwrap(),
